3. HOW TO APPLY:
a. The prescribed format for application can be downloaded from the
Kohima Bench website www.kohimahiqhcourt,gov.in.
b. Candidates shall fill up the application form and paste a passport sized
photo in the given space and sign across the photograph. 2 (two) copies
of the same passport photo should be enclosed with the application.
C. The application should be submitted to the Registrar, Gauhati High Court
Kohima Bench. Applications submItted in any other mode, except as
indicated above will be rejected.

d. Demand Draft/ Banker’s Cheque for Rs. 500/- (Rupees Five Hundred

for Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe candidates payable to the
Registrar, Gauhati High Court Kohima Bench should be enclosed with the
application form.

candidature of any candidate and the High Court reserves the right to
reject the candidature if any candidate at any subsequent stage.
The High Court reserves the right to cancel the Advertisement,
alter/modify or change any term and condition including selection
process etc. spelt out in the Advertisement.
Candidates are advised to regularly visit the High Court website for
updates and information on the recruitment process.
